subproblem.title: Area formulas for an integer-weighted oriented Lipschitz piece (supplied step 8)
subproblem.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N and A ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, such that G is differentiable at every u ∈ A, DG(u) := fderiv ℝ G u is injective for every u ∈ A, and G is injective on A. Let θ : ℝ^N → ℕ, ξ : ℝ^N → Λ_n(ℝ^N) (MultiVector N n) and s : ℝⁿ → ℤ with s(u) ∈ {1, −1} for every u (no measurability assumed). Write e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1, v(u) := (DG(u)e_a)_{a<n}, J(u) := √det(⟨DG(u)e_a, DG(u)e_b⟩)_{a,b}, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^N and λ := volume on ℝⁿ, and assume J(u)·ξ(G(u))(α) = s(u)·α(v(u)) for λ⌞A-a.e. u and every n-covector α. Put w(u) := θ(G(u))·s(u) ∈ ℤ. Then (i) ∫_A ofReal(|w(u)|·J(u)) dλ(u) = ∫_{G(A)} θ dHⁿ in [0, ∞]; and (ii) for every n-form ω : ℝ^N → Λⁿ(ℝ^N) (DifferentialForm (Euclid N) n; no regularity required), ∫_A w(u)·ω(G(u))(v(u)) dλ(u) = ∫_{G(A)} θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x), as Bochner integrals (no integrability assumed).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (θ : Euclid N → ℕ) (ξ : Euclid N → MultiVector N n) (s : Euclid n → ℤ), MeasurableSet A → (∀ u ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G u) → (∀ u ∈ A, Injective (fderiv ℝ G u)) → InjOn G A → (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) → (∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * ξ (G u) α = (s u : ℝ) * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) → ∫⁻ u in A, ENNReal.ofReal (|(((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ) : ℝ)| * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) = ∫⁻ x in G '' A, (θ x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) n, ∫ u in A, (((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ) : ℝ) * ω (G u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = ∫ x in G '' A, (θ x : ℝ) * ξ x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 (area formulas) of the supplied proof, together with the per-piece identities used in its steps 9 and 11, for one piece. The supplied proof uses G := G_i, A := A_i, θ the multiplicity, ξ the orientation and s := s_i, so w = w_i and J = c_i.

Notation: Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^N; λ := volume on ℝⁿ; e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1; DG(u) := fderiv ℝ G u; v(u) := (DG(u)e_a)_{a ∈ Fin n}; J(u) := √det(⟨v_a(u), v_b(u)⟩)_{a,b}; w(u) := θ(G(u))·s(u) ∈ ℤ.

1. (|w| = θ∘G.) For every u, |w(u)| = θ(G(u))·|s(u)| = θ(G(u)), because s(u) ∈ {1, −1} and θ(G(u)) ≥ 0.
2. (Proof of (i).) Apply the accepted theorem codim1_lura_gram_area_formula, part (ii), with m := n, P := N, f := G, s := A and g := θ, viewed as a [0, ∞]-valued function. Its hypotheses are exactly ours: A Borel; G differentiable at every point of A; DG injective on A; G injective on A. Note that g need not be measurable. Its Jacobian is J, so ∫_{G(A)} θ dHⁿ = ∫_A ofReal(J(u))·θ(G(u)) dλ(u). For every u, by step 1, ofReal(|w(u)|·J(u)) = ofReal(θ(G(u))·J(u)) = θ(G(u))·ofReal(J(u)) (ENNReal.ofReal_mul with θ(G(u)) ≥ 0, and ofReal of a natural number is that number). The two integrands agree everywhere (lintegral_congr), which gives (i).
3. (Proof of (ii).) Fix an n-form ω and put h(x) := θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) for x ∈ ℝ^N. The accepted theorem codim1_lur_cd_injective_area_formula_gram (with P := N, m := n, the map G, F := A and h; same hypotheses as in step 2; no integrability needed) gives ∫_{G(A)} h dHⁿ = ∫_A J(u)·h(G(u)) dλ(u).
4. (The integrands agree a.e.) Let u be in the λ⌞A-conull set where the hypothesis J(u)·ξ(G(u))(α) = s(u)·α(v(u)) holds for all α. With α := ω(G(u)): J(u)·h(G(u)) = θ(G(u))·(J(u)·ξ(G(u))(ω(G(u)))) = θ(G(u))·s(u)·ω(G(u))(v(u)) = w(u)·ω(G(u))(v(u)).
5. Integrals of λ⌞A-a.e. equal functions coincide (integral_congr_ae for the measure λ⌞A), for any functions, integrable or not. By steps 3 and 4, ∫_A w(u)·ω(G(u))(v(u)) dλ(u) = ∫_A J(u)·h(G(u)) dλ(u) = ∫_{G(A)} θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x). This is (ii). ∎

```lean
theorem Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pr_oriented_piece_area : ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (θ : Euclid N → ℕ) (ξ : Euclid N → MultiVector N n) (s : Euclid n → ℤ), MeasurableSet A → (∀ u ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G u) → (∀ u ∈ A, Injective (fderiv ℝ G u)) → InjOn G A → (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) → (∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * ξ (G u) α = (s u : ℝ) * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) → ∫⁻ u in A, ENNReal.ofReal (|(((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ) : ℝ)| * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) = ∫⁻ x in G '' A, (θ x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) n, ∫ u in A, (((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ) : ℝ) * ω (G u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = ∫ x in G '' A, (θ x : ℝ) * ξ x (ω x) ∂μHE[n] := by
  intro N n G A θ ξ s hA hdiff hinj hInjOn hs hstar
  constructor
  · rw [(Submission.codim1_lura_gram_area_formula n N G).2 A hA hdiff hinj hInjOn
      (fun x => (θ x : ℝ≥0∞))]
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro u
    have habs : |((((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ)) : ℝ)| = (θ (G u) : ℝ) := by
      rcases hs u with h | h <;> simp [h]
    rw [habs, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, mul_comm]
  · intro ω
    rw [Submission.codim1_lur_cd_injective_area_formula_gram N n G A hA hdiff hinj hInjOn]
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hstar] with u hu
    have h1 := hu (ω (G u))
    push_cast
    calc ((θ (G u) : ℝ) * (s u : ℝ)) * ω (G u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
        = (θ (G u) : ℝ) * ((s u : ℝ) * ω (G u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [← h1]; ring
```
proof_key_steps: codim1_lura_gram_area_formula with g := θ, and ofReal(θ(G u)·J(u)) = θ(G u)·ofReal(J(u)), give (i).
codim1_lur_cd_injective_area_formula_gram with h := θ·ξ(ω) gives ∫_{G(A)} h dHⁿ = ∫_A J·h∘G dλ.
The a.e. identity J·ξ(G u)(α) = s(u)·α(v(u)) with α := ω(G u) turns J·h∘G into w·ω(G)(v) a.e. on A; integral_congr_ae gives (ii).
